messages:
Ravi: Hey design, quick ask for next week's launch push. Need a tiny asset set: 1) 2-up hero (desktop + mobile) for webinar landing; 2) one-panel infographic for sales (portrait PNG + SVG); 3) a 6-frame storyboard PDF that lays out the benchmark narrative for the webinar speaker. All must be brand-compliant and ready for localization. Due: Fri noon PT.
Jules: On it. Can you share the benchmark topline we should visualize? and any narrative bullets for the storyboard?
Ravi: Toplines: p50 latency ~40ms, cost/token $0.00085, batching gives ~2.7x cost efficiency. Storyboard bullets: problem (unpredictable inference cost), solution (Redwood unified serving + caching/batching), outcome (lower unit cost + consistent latency), CTA (register). Keep the storyboard concise 1-2 sentences per frame.
Maya: Brand constraints reminder: use Primary Blue for highlights, Accent Yellow only for callouts, no gradients on small assets, type scale per brand token. Ensure 4.5:1 contrast for body text.
Felix: Delivery formats? I need SVG for the infographic and mobile hero as 1080x1350 PNG. Also an A4 printable storyboard PDF and a 1200x628 email banner. File naming convention: launch_bench_hero_v1.png, launch_bench_hero_mobile_v1.png, launch_bench_info_v1.svg, launch_bench_storyboard_v1.pdf, launch_bench_email_1200x628_v1.png. Tag everything with #launch-bench.
Ravi: Add legal note: "Based on internal testing; customer results may vary" in 9pt at bottom of infographic. No customer logos.
Jules: For the infographic, do we want exact numbers or rounded? Small audience will appreciate exacts but German localization needs wider text box.
Maya: Use rounded numbers in visuals (40ms, $0.0009) and include precise figures in the footnote. Leave extra horizontal padding for DE.
Felix: Motion ask: optional animated SVG for the social preview with a subtle sparkline. If file size/complexity is an issue, export static PNG only.
Ravi: Prioritize static assets. If time permits, we can add the SVG animation as a second pass.
Jules: Uploading first comps to Figma in ~3 hours under page "Bench Launch / Storyboard". Frames: HERO_DESKTOP, HERO_MOBILE, INFO_SVG_MASTER, STORYBOARD_PAGES.
design-bot: Reminder set for 36h to check for Jules uploads.
Maya: Accessibility QA 1 will check color contrast and type legibility at 320px width.
Felix: Will export final assets as requested and drop a zip in the shared drive when approved.
Ravi: Thanks team. If we hit any blockers, ship hero + email banner first and stagger infographic/storyboard.
Jules: Noted. I'll ping once comps are live for reviews.
